content:
Born in 1995 in Brest (France), I am a software developer currently living in Montreal.
      I started photography as a hobby after moving to Canada. I use this site to share my shots from trips across Europe and North America, focusing on city architecture and natural landscapes.
Gear Camera: Sony Alpha 6700 + Sigma 18-50mm f/2.8 Drone: DJI Mini 5 Pro Mobile: iPhone 17

title: About Romain Charretteur

content: Feel the dual soul of North America’s most eclectic island. From the adrenaline of the Formula 1 tracks and towering street murals to the glowing neon of the Quartier des Spectacles, capture the vibrant pulse of a city that lives for the moment.
